title: Dolphin Watching Key West and Snorkeling
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This isn’t a packed tourist boat — it’s a true small-group adventure with a maximum of 6 guests. You’re not watching dolphins from far away; you’re close enough to feel that electric moment when they swim right next to the boat. Our captains know the dolphin pods by territory and behavior, so you spend more time with them and less time searching.

After the dolphin encounter, we take you to hand-picked spots that big boats can’t access: clear, shallow water, quiet backcountry reefs, and hidden sandbars. Beginners feel safe, families feel relaxed, and experienced snorkelers get genuinely good underwater visibility. Personalized, unhurried, and run by a local crew that actually cares — that’s what sets this trip apart.
